identification: Red 1980s-style superstrat, pointy six-in-line (Jackson/Charvel-type) headstock, black hardware, locking (Floyd-type) tremolo, HSS pickups (bridge humbucker, two single coils), one volume and one tone knob with mini toggle switches between them instead of a 5-way blade, and a side-mounted jack in a square plate on the lower bout edge. That control and jack layout matches the 1986-89 Japanese Charvel Model series (Model 3: HSS, mini on/off toggles, side jack). Brand unconfirmed: headstock logo not legible. Plus a small black practice combo amp (about 10-20 W, 6-7 knobs, unbranded at this resolution).

viewing_check: Read the headstock logo (Charvel / Jackson / other) and the neck plate serial (Charvel MIJ serials are 6-digit, often starting with 2); count the knobs and mini toggles (Model 4: 3 and 3); check the trem make (Kahler, Jackson JT6 or Floyd), frets, neck relief, battery box at the back (active). Read the amp brand and plug it in.
